paragraphs: As used in this Annual Report, unless the context indicates or otherwise requires, "ARS," "ARS Pharma," the "company," "we," "us," "our," and other similar terms refer to ARS Pharmaceuticals, Inc., a Delaware corporation and its consolidated subsidiaries.

neffy and EURneffy are trademarks of ours that we use in this Annual Report. This Annual Report also includes trademarks, trade names, and service marks that are the property of other organizations. Solely for convenience, our trademarks and trade names referred to in this Annual Report appear without the ® or  symbols, but those references are not intended to indicate, in any way, that we will not assert, to the fullest extent under applicable law, our rights, or the right of the applicable licensor, to our trademark and trade names. The use or display of other companies' trade names or trademarks do not suggest or imply a relationship or affiliation with, or endorsement or sponsorship of us by, any other companies.

We are a biopharmaceutical company focused on the commercialization and development of neffy (currently identified in the European Union ("EU") and United Kingdom ("U.K.") by the trade name EURneffy and in China by the trade name 优敏速) for needle-free intranasal delivery of epinephrine for emergency treatment of Type I allergic reactions, including anaphylaxis. neffy is the first and only FDA and European Commission ("EC")-approved needle-free epinephrine product, and also has approvals in the U.K., Japan, Australia, and China. It is the first new delivery method for epinephrine in more than 35 years. neffy is a proprietary composition of epinephrine with an innovative absorption enhancer called Intravail, which allows neffy to safely provide intranasal delivery of epinephrine at a low dose within the exposures of approved injectable products across a range of dosing conditions (including repeat dosing and allergen challenge).

We believe neffy's "no needle, no injection" approach addresses a significant unmet need in the use of epinephrine. There are approximately 40 million people in the U.S. who experience Type I allergic reactions. Of this group, approximately 20 million people are reported to have been diagnosed and experienced severe Type I allergic reactions that may lead to anaphylaxis, and approximately 6.5 million of those were prescribed an epinephrine autoinjector. However, in recent years, only an estimated one-half of those consistently fill their prescribed autoinjector with them. We believe the market opportunity for neffy in the U.S. is significant. Those estimated 3.2 million patients who currently fill their active epinephrine autoinjector prescription would represent approximately $1.8 billion in annual U.S. net sales at neffy's estimated gross-to-net yield based on epinephrine device unit volume in 2025.

In August 2024, the FDA approved neffy 2 mg for the emergency treatment of Type I allergic reactions, including anaphylaxis, in adults and children who weigh 30 kg or greater, with neffy 1 mg subsequently approved in March 2025 for patients who are four years of age and older and weigh 15 kg to less than 30 kg. Our commercialization efforts for neffy currently include a direct sales force of 106 individuals targeting high-volume prescribers, an additional co-promotion U.S. sales force of approximately 70 individuals with our partner, ALK-Abelló, Inc. ("ALK U.S.", an affiliate of ALK-Abelló A/S ("ALK")), targeting pediatricians that launched in May 2025, as well as our getneffy.com virtual prescriber website formally launched in November 2025 to minimize physician and patient burden. Our sales force and virtual prescriber options are supported by branded direct-to-consumer marketing through streaming platforms, traditional broadcast and cable television, consumer-facing digital channels, non-personal promotion with healthcare providers, and disease awareness campaigns with advocacy groups.

Our U.S. commercial launch is building momentum, and our launch data shows meaningful physician and patient demand. As of February 2026, more than 22,500 physicians have prescribed neffy since launch. With increasing demand, we're securing broad insurance coverage, which we believe is a critical factor for accelerating adoption in the high patient volume epinephrine market. Currently, we have approximately 93% overall commercial coverage, inclusive of plans that may still require prior authorization, approximately 57% coverage with commercial insurance without prior authorization, and 8 of 50 Medicaid states covering neffy without prior authorization.

The EC has granted marketing authorization in the EU for EURneffy 2 mg (the trade name for neffy 2 mg in the EU and U.K.), for the emergency treatment of Type I allergic reactions, including anaphylaxis, in adults and children who weigh 30 kg or greater and on January 29, 2026, the Committee for Medicinal Products for Human Use ("CHMP") of the EMA adopted a positive opinion, recommending marketing authorization in the EU for EURneffy 1 mg for children who are four years of age and older and weigh 15 kg to less than 30 kg. Through our collaboration with ALK, EURneffy 2 mg was launched in Europe, beginning with Germany in June 2025, followed by the U.K. in October 2025. We received approval of neffy 2 mg and 1 mg in Japan in September 2025, which is expected to launch in the first quarter of 2026 by our collaboration partner, Alfresa. We also received approval of neffy 2 mg and 1 mg doses in Australia in December 2025, with commercial launch by our collaboration partner, Seqirus, initiated in February 2026. In December 2025, we received approval in China of 优敏速 (the trade name for neffy 2 mg in China), with commercial launch by our collaboration partner, Pediatrix, expected to start in the first half of 2026. neffy 2 mg is under review by Health Canada, with a regulatory decision expected in the second quarter of 2026 and if approved, commercial launch by our collaboration partner, ALK, expected to start later in 2026. neffy has already been approved or is under regulatory review in countries representing approximately 98% of the current global epinephrine autoinjector sales. For more information regarding our partners and collaboration agreements, see "Business—Our Collaboration and Licensing Agreements."

Real-world data supports that neffy delivers similar response rates as injections for the emergency treatment of Type I allergic reactions. In September 2025, we reported survey results of anaphylaxis treatment outcomes in the neffy experience program, which provides 1 mg and 2 mg doses of neffy to allergists for in-office use if patients experience an anaphylactic event during oral food challenges or allergen immunotherapy. These results showed that approximately 90% of patients experiencing anaphylaxis symptoms were effectively treated with a single dose of neffy, which is consistent with that historically reported for epinephrine injection. The results were presented as an oral presentation at the American College of Allergy, Asthma and Immunology ("ACAAI") meeting in early November 2025 and was also published in the Annals of Allergy, Asthma and Immunology, the official peer-reviewed journal of the ACAAI, in December 2025.

We reported positive topline results demonstrating statistically significant and clinically meaningful improvements in treatment-refractory chronic urticaria patients at the American Academy of Allergy and Immunology medical conference in February 2024. In the second quarter of 2025, we initiated a Phase 2b randomized, placebo-controlled outpatient clinical trial involving chronic spontaneous urticaria patients on chronic treatment regimens, who still experience flares or exacerbations. Interim data from this clinical trial is anticipated in the second half of 2026, followed by the potential initiation of a single pivotal efficacy study in mid-2027. We estimate that there are approximately 1.5 million diagnosed chronic urticaria patients in the U.S., of whom approximately half are not well-controlled by antihistamines and continue to experience multiple acute flares a year, and therefore would be prescribed multiple epinephrine nasal spray devices if approved. The chronic urticaria indication represents an addressable market opportunity of more than $2.0 billion annually based on neffy's current net pricing.

We currently own, co-own and exclusively license a robust global intellectual property portfolio including issued composition of matter and method patents relating to neffy and our intranasal epinephrine technology product candidates that are not expected to expire until 2038.

Type I allergic reactions are potentially life-threatening hypersensitivity reactions that can occur within minutes of exposure to an allergen and need to be treated immediately to relieve symptoms and prevent further progression. Initial symptoms significantly impact patient quality of life and include difficulty breathing, bronchospasms, hypotension, presyncope, itching, hives, swelling of eyes and lips, and abdominal pain and vomiting. If not treated immediately, more severe reactions known as anaphylaxis that involve constriction of the airways, swelling of the throat, rapid heart rate, severe hypotension and other respiratory and cardiac symptoms can develop and potentially present a medical and life-threatening emergency. Immediate administration of epinephrine is currently the only first-line treatment for Type I allergic reactions, including anaphylaxis. The only out-of-hospital delivery option today is an intra-muscular injectable product, typically offered as prefilled syringes or auto-injector devices, such as EpiPen, which is marketed by Viatris Inc., and generic versions of EpiPen, marketed by Teva Pharmaceuticals, Inc. These intra-muscular auto-injection devices have several limitations that include:
• they lack convenience of portability, with only 50% of patients who fill their prescriptions carrying the device;
• patients are reluctant to use the device, with approximately 25% to 60% of patients who carry the device refusing to administer;
• apprehension stemming from the use of a needle that leads to approximately 40% to 60% of patients delaying administration by up to 18 minutes even if they are carrying the device;

paragraphs: We operate in a dynamic and rapidly changing environment that involves numerous risks and uncertainties. Certain factors may have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition and results of operations, and you should carefully consider them. Accordingly, in evaluating our business, we encourage you to consider the following discussion of risk factors, in its entirety, in addition to other information contained in this Annual Report and our other public filings with the SEC. Other events that we do not currently anticipate or that we currently deem immaterial may also affect our results of operations and financial condition.

We are highly dependent on the successful commercialization of neffy. To the extent neffy and EURneffy are not commercially successful, our business, financial condition and results of operations would be materially adversely affected, and the price of our common stock would likely decline.

neffy is our only product that has been approved for sale. Currently, neffy has been approved for the emergency treatment of allergic reactions (anaphylaxis) in the United States, EU, United Kingdom, Japan and Australia (in the case of neffy 2 mg and 1 mg) and China (in the case of neffy 2 mg). We are focusing a significant portion of our activities and resources on neffy, and we believe our near-term revenues are highly dependent on, and a meaningful portion of the value of our company relates to, our ability to successfully commercialize neffy in the United States and abroad through our collaboration partners. Successful commercialization of neffy is subject to many risks. Prior to neffy, we have not, as an organization, commercialized any product, and there is no guarantee that we will be able to do so successfully with neffy. There are numerous examples of unsuccessful product launches and failures to meet high expectations of market potential, including by pharmaceutical companies with more experience and resources than we have. The commercial success of neffy depends on the extent to which patients and physicians accept and adopt neffy as a treatment of Type I allergic reactions, including anaphylaxis, and we do not know whether our or others' estimates in this regard will be accurate. For example, if the population of patients who may suffer a Type I allergic reaction is smaller than we estimate or if physicians are unwilling to prescribe or patients are unwilling to use neffy for any reason, the commercial potential of neffy will be limited. It is too soon to tell how physicians, patients and payors will respond to the pricing of neffy. Physicians may not prescribe neffy and patients may be unwilling to use neffy if coverage is not provided or reimbursement is inadequate to cover a significant portion of the cost. Additionally, any negative development for neffy in post-approval trials or potential additional indications, including urticaria, or in regulatory processes in other jurisdictions, may adversely impact the commercial results and potential of neffy. Thus, significant uncertainty remains regarding the commercial potential of neffy. If the commercialization of neffy is unsuccessful or perceived as disappointing, our stock price could decline significantly and the long-term success of the product and our company could be harmed.

We have built a sales force and entered into the ALK Co-Promotion Agreement to commercialize neffy in the United States. In order to successfully commercialize neffy, we must, among other things, continue to build our sales, marketing, distribution, managerial and other non-technical capabilities. Factors that may hinder our ability to successfully market and commercially distribute our products include:
• inability of sales personnel to obtain access to or educate adequate numbers of physicians on the benefits and safety of prescribing neffy;
• inability to recruit, retain and effectively manage adequate numbers of effective sales personnel, including ALK U.S. sales personnel;

Since our inception in 2015 as ARS Pharmaceuticals, Inc., we have devoted substantially all of our efforts to developing intellectual property, conducting product development and clinical trials, organizing and staffing, business planning, raising capital, building infrastructure, pre-commercial and commercial activities, and providing general and administrative support for these operations. We have funded our operations primarily with proceeds from the merger with Silverback Therapeutics, Inc. ("Silverback") in November 2022, private placement of convertible preferred stock, issuance of common stock, licensing, supply and distribution arrangements with our commercialization partners, debt, and net product sales. As of December 31, 2025, we had cash, cash equivalents, and short-term investments of $245.0 million.

We have incurred net losses in most years since our inception. Net loss for the year ended December 31, 2025 was $171.3 million, and net income for the year ended December 31, 2024 was $8.0 million. As of December 31, 2025, we had an accumulated deficit of $294.6 million. Until we consistently generate positive net income, if ever, our net losses may fluctuate significantly from quarter-to-quarter and year-to-year, depending on the timing of our clinical trials, our expenditures on other development activities, the cost for regulatory filings, expenses for commercial activities to establish, maintain and enhance sales, marketing and distribution capabilities for neffy, the timing and volume of our product sales, and our ability to earn potential royalties and regulatory and commercial milestones under our license and collaboration arrangements.

Until such time, if ever, that we can generate substantial product revenue, we may finance our operations through our existing cash, cash equivalents, short-term investments, equity offerings, debt financings and other capital sources which may include collaborations, strategic alliances, marketing, distribution or licensing arrangements or other arrangements with third parties. However, we may be unable to raise additional funds or enter into such other arrangements when needed on favorable terms or at all. In addition, any future debt agreements may limit our ability to enter into certain debt financings without the consent of the lenders thereunder. On September 29, 2025 we entered into a Credit Agreement (the "Credit Agreement") with RA Capital Agency Services, LLC (as the "Administrative Agent") and affiliates of OMERS Administration Corporation and RA Capital Management, L.P. as lenders (the "Lenders"), which provides for an aggregate principal amount of up to $250.0 million of term loans from the Lenders to us (the "Credit Facility"). Subject to limited exceptions, we are prohibited from incurring additional indebtedness and entering into certain strategic and licensing transactions without the prior written consent of the Lenders pursuant to the Credit Agreement. Our failure to raise capital or enter into such other arrangements when needed would have a negative impact on our financial condition and may require us to delay or reduce our marketing and sales efforts, or delay, reduce or terminate our research and development programs or other operations, or grant rights to develop and market products or product candidates that we would otherwise prefer to develop and market ourselves.

We do not own or operate manufacturing facilities. We currently rely on third-party manufacturers and suppliers for neffy and our intranasal epinephrine technology product candidates, and we expect to continue to do so to meet our nonclinical, clinical and commercial activities. Our third-party manufacturers are required to manufacture our product under cGMP requirements and other applicable laws and regulations.

We have recognized net product sales in the United States since the commercial launch of neffy in September 2024. We have signed collaboration and license agreements for neffy for all geographies outside of the United States. The terms of these agreements may include payment to us of one or more of the following: non-refundable, upfront license fees; clinical, regulatory, and/or commercial milestone payments; clinical development fees; and royalties or a transfer price on net sales of licensed products if neffy receives marketing approval in these regions. We expect product revenues to fluctuate in future periods as we continue with the commercial launch of neffy. We expect revenues under collaboration agreements to fluctuate in future periods based on our ability to meet various regulatory milestones, and contingent on successfully obtaining regulatory approval for neffy in the licensed regions, commercial milestones, royalties or transfer price earned from our partner's net sales and the supply of commercial product as set forth in the agreements described earlier.

Cost of goods sold consists primarily of direct and indirect costs to manufacture neffy for commercial sale, including third-party manufacturing costs, raw material and component costs, excess or obsolete inventory adjustment charges, inventory write offs, packaging services, freight, storage costs, distribution fees, amortization of capitalized in-licensed costs, royalties on product sales, salaries and related expenses for personnel, and stock-based compensation. Prior to the FDA approval of neffy in August 2024, certain inventory components were purchased to manufacture neffy and recorded as research and development expenses, resulting in zero-cost inventory components. As a result, the cost of goods sold related to neffy will initially reflect a lower average per unit cost of materials, as previously expensed inventory components are consumed in commercial production and sold to customers.

我們是一家生物製藥公司，專注於 neffy（目前在歐盟（"EU"）及英國（"U.K."）以 EURneffy 為商號，在中國以 優敏速 為商號）的商業化與開發，用於無針鼻內給藥方式提供腎上腺素，用以緊急治療 Type I 過敏反應，包括過敏性休克。neffy 是第一且唯一獲得美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）及歐盟委員會（"EC"）批准的無針腎上腺素產品，也已獲得英國、日本、澳洲及中國的批准。它是超過 35 年來第一種新的腎上腺素給藥方式。neffy 是一種專利的腎上腺素組成物，搭配創新吸收增強劑 Intravail，使 neffy 能在批准的注射產品的暴露條件下，安全地以低劑量提供鼻內腎上腺素給藥（包括重複給藥及過敏原挑戰）。

我們認為 neffy 的 "無針、無注射" 方式解決了腎上腺素使用上的重大未滿足需求。美國約有 4000 萬人會經歷 Type I 過敏反應。在這羣人中，約有 2000 萬人被診斷並經歷嚴重 Type I 過敏反應，可能導致過敏性休克，其中約有 650 萬人被處方腎上腺素自動注射器。然而，近年來，僅估計有約一半的人會持續填寫他們的處方自動注射器。我們認為 neffy 在美國的市場潛力非常大。目前約有 320 萬人填寫他們的主動腎上腺素自動注射器處方，根據 2025 年腎上腺素裝置單位體積，預估 neffy 的年美國淨銷售額將達 18 億美元。

2024 年 8 月，FDA 批准 neffy 2 mg 用於成人及體重 30 公斤或以上的兒童，用以緊急治療 Type I 過敏反應，包括過敏性休克，隨後於 2025 年 3 月批准 neffy 1 mg 用於年齡四歲以上且體重 15 公斤至少於 30 公斤的患者。我們目前的 neffy 商業化工作包括 106 名直接銷售團隊成員，目標為高處方量開方者，另外與我們的合作夥伴 ALK-Abelló, Inc.（"ALK U.S."，ALK-Abelló A/S（"ALK"）的子公司）合作的美國共推銷售團隊約有 70 名成員，目標為小兒科醫生，於 2025 年 5 月啟動，以及我們的 getneffy.com 虛擬開方者網站於 2025 年 11 月正式啟動，以減少醫生與患者的負擔。我們的銷售團隊與虛擬開方者選項由品牌直接對消費者行銷活動支持，透過串流平台、傳統廣播與有線電視、消費者面對面數位頻道、非個人推廣與醫療專業人員，以及與倡議團體的合作疾病意識活動。

我們的美國商業發售正在建立動能，發售數據顯示醫生與患者的顯著需求。截至 2026 年 2 月，發售以來已有超過 22,500 名醫生開處 neffy。隨著需求增加，我們正在爭取廣泛的保險覆蓋，我們認為這是加速在高患者數量腎上腺素市場採用的關鍵因素。目前，我們的總體商業覆蓋率約為 93%，包括可能仍需事前審核的計畫，約 57% 的商業保險覆蓋率無需事前審核，以及 50 個 Medicaid 狀態中 8 個無需事前審核覆蓋 neffy。

歐盟委員會已批准 EURneffy 2 mg（在歐盟及英國（"U.K."）中 neffy 2 mg 的商號）用於成人及體重 30 公斤或以上的兒童，用以緊急治療 Type I 過敏反應，包括過敏性休克。2026 年 1 月 29 日，歐盟藥物評估委員會（"CHMP"）採納了正面意見，建議批准 EURneffy 1 mg 用於年齡四歲以上且體重 15 公斤至少於 30 公斤的兒童。透過與 ALK 的合作，EURneffy 2 mg 在歐洲於 2025 年 6 月開始在德國發售，隨後於 2025 年 10 月在英國發售。我們在 2025 年 9 月獲得 neffy 2 mg 和 1 mg 在日本的批准，預計由合作夥伴 Alfresa 於 2026 年第一季發售。我們也在 2025 年 12 月獲得 neffy 2 mg 和 1 mg 在澳洲的批准，由合作夥伴 Seqirus 於 2026 年 2 月開始商業發售。2025 年 12 月，我們在中國獲得 優敏速（neffy 2 mg 在中國的商號）的批准，預計由合作夥伴 Pediatrix 於 2026 年第一季開始商業發售。neffy 2 mg 正在加拿大健康部審查中，預計於 2026 年第二季做出監管決定，若批准，預計由合作夥伴 ALK 於 2026 年後期開始商業發售。neffy 已經獲得批准或正在進行監管審查的國家，代表目前全球腎上腺素自動注射器銷售的約 98%。如需有關我們合作夥伴及合作協議的更多資訊，請參閱 "業務—我們的合作與授權協議。"

實證數據支持 neffy 提供與注射相似的反應率，用以緊急治療 Type I 過敏反應。2025 年 9 月，我們報告了 anaphylaxis 治療結果的調查結果，該調查在 neffy 經驗計畫中進行，提供 1 mg 和 2 mg 劑量的 neffy 給過敏科醫生，用於患者在口服食物挑戰或過敏原免疫療法期間經歷 anaphylactic 事件時的診所使用。這些結果顯示，約有 90% 的患者在經歷 anaphylaxis 症狀時，經由單劑 neffy 有效治療，與歷史報告的腎上腺素注射結果一致。這些結果以口頭報告形式在 2025 年 11 月初的美國過敏、氣喘及免疫學會（"ACAAI"）會議中發表，並於 2025 年 12 月發表在《過敏、氣喘及免疫學年鑑》（ACAAI 的官方同儕審查期刊）上。

我們在2024年2月於美國過敏與免疫學會醫療會議上報告了正面的營業收入表現，顯示在治療難治性慢性蕁麻疹患者方面具有統計學意義且臨牀意義重大的改善。2025年第二季，我們啟動了一項針對慢性自發性蕁麻疹患者的第二期雙盲安慰劑對照門診臨牀試驗，這些患者正在接受慢性治療方案，但仍會出現發作或惡化。此臨牀試驗的中期數據預計在2026年下半年公佈，隨後可能於2027年中啟動單一關鍵性有效性試驗。我們估計美國約有1.5百萬名診斷為慢性蕁麻疹的患者，其中約一半的患者無法透過抗組織胺藥物有效控制，每年仍會經歷多次急性發作，因此若獲得核准，將會被處方多個腎上腺素鼻噴劑裝置。慢性蕁麻疹的適應症代表了一個年營收超過2.0十億美元的可達市場機會，基於neffy目前的淨售價。
我們目前擁有、共同擁有並獨家授權一個強大的全球智慧財產權組合，包括已發明的組成物及方法專利，這些專利與neffy及我們的鼻內腎上腺素產品候選藥物相關，預計不會在2038年前過期。

Type I過敏反應是潛在致命的過敏反應，可能在接觸過敏原後數分鐘內發生，必須立即治療以緩解症狀並防止進一步惡化。初期症狀會顯著影響患者的健康生活品質，包括呼吸困難、支氣管痙攣、低血壓、暈厥前兆、癢、風疹、眼睛和嘴脣腫脹，以及腹痛和嘔吐。若未立即治療，可能會發展為更嚴重的反應，稱為過敏性休克，涉及氣道收縮、喉頭腫脹、心跳加速、嚴重低血壓及其他呼吸和心臟症狀，可能導致醫療及生命威脅的緊急情況。目前，腎上腺素注射是治療Type I過敏反應，包括過敏性休克的唯一一線治療方式。目前唯一的非醫院外使用方式是肌肉注射產品，通常以預灌封針筒或自動注射器裝置提供，例如由Viatris Inc.行銷的EpiPen，以及由Teva Pharmaceuticals, Inc.行銷的EpiPen仿製品。這些肌肉注射自動注射器裝置有幾個限制，包括：
• 裝置缺乏便攜性，僅有50%的患者在領取處方後會攜帶該裝置；
• 患者不願意使用該裝置，約有25%至60%的患者即使攜帶裝置也會拒絕使用；
• 因使用針頭而產生的恐懼感，導致約有40%至60%的患者即使攜帶裝置也會延遲使用達18分鐘。

paragraphs: 你應閱讀下列討論與分析，並與我們的財務報表及相關附註，包含於本年度報告的「第 8 項 財務報表與補充資料」一同參考。下列討論包含前瞻性陳述，涉及風險與不確定性。有關前瞻性陳述的完整討論，請參閱上文標題為「前瞻性陳述」的章節。我們的實際結果可能因多種因素而與任何前瞻性陳述中所表達或暗示的結果有重大差異，包括於「第 1A 項 風險因素」標題下所列的風險因素。

我們是一家專注於 neffy（目前在歐盟（"EU"）及英國（"U.K."）以商標 EURneffy 識別，在中國以商標 優敏速 識別）的生物製藥公司，用於無針鼻內給藥方式提供腎上腺素，用以緊急治療 Type I 過敏反應，包括過敏性休克。neffy 是美國食品藥物管理局（"FDA"）及歐盟委員會批准的首款無針腎上腺素產品，也已獲英國、日本、澳洲及中國批准。它是超過 35 年來首款新的腎上腺素給藥方式。neffy 是一種專利的腎上腺素組成，搭配創新吸收增強劑 Intravail，使 neffy 能在批准的注射產品暴露條件下，安全地以低劑量提供鼻內腎上腺素給藥（包括重複給藥及過敏原挑戰）。我們認為 neffy 在美國的市場潛力非常大。以目前 neffy 的標價及我們目標總毛利率至淨銷售額的轉換率計算，目前美國約有 6.5 百萬名患者被處方腎上腺素自動注射器，這代表初步可接觸市場潛力約為每年 3.5 十億美元的淨銷售額，而另外 13.5 百萬名被診斷但尚未被處方腎上腺素產品的患者，則代表額外可接觸市場潛力約為每年 7.0 十億美元的淨銷售額。

我們認為 neffy 的「無針、無注射」方式解決了腎上腺素使用中一個重要的未被滿足的醫療需求。美國約有 40 百萬人會經歷 Type I 過敏反應。在這羣人中，約有 20 百萬人被報導已診斷並經歷嚴重的 Type I 過敏反應，可能導致過敏性休克，其中約有 6.5 百萬人已被處方腎上腺素自動注射器。然而，近年來，僅估計約一半的患者會持續攜帶他們的處方自動注射器。我們認為 neffy 在美國的市場潛力非常大。那些目前填寫其活躍腎上腺素自動注射器處方的估計 3.2 百萬名患者，根據 2025 年腎上腺素裝置單元體積計算，以 neffy 的目標估計總毛利率至淨銷售額轉換率計算，將代表每年美國約 1.8 十億美元的淨銷售額。

2024 年 8 月，FDA 批准 neffy 2 mg 用以緊急治療 Type I 過敏反應，包括過敏性休克，適用於體重 30 公斤或以上的成人及兒童，隨後於 2025 年 3 月批准 neffy 1 mg 用以治療年齡四歲以上且體重 15 公斤至少於 30 公斤的患者。我們在美國的 neffy 推廣策略包括直接與約佔去年處方量 55% 的高處方量醫師接觸，透過高效的銷售團隊。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們的銷售團隊約有 106 名 ARS Pharma 員工，擔任銷售代表、關鍵客戶經理、區域銷售經理及國家銷售總監，以及 10 名虛擬銷售代表，以及約 70 名銷售代表透過我們的共同推廣夥伴 ALK U.S.，該夥伴於 2025 年 6 月開始進行現場作業，並將針對美國最多達 9,000 名指定小兒科醫師及其他處方醫師。我們計畫於 2026 年第二季開始擴充內部銷售團隊至約 150 名人員。有關我們的夥伴及合作協議，請參閱「業務—我們的合作與授權協議」。

我們的發佈策略也受到以下因素支撐：自2024年11月起，約有2,800位醫療專業人員參與我們的neffy體驗計畫，讓醫療專業人員能實際使用neffy作為過敏性休克的急救療法，於診所內的過敏原挑戰測試中使用，以及持續收集真實世界證據，以支持neffy與注射療法的臨牀等效性；廣泛的非人際推廣，包括與過敏科協會合作的醫療教育計畫、講者機構、同儕對同儕計畫，以及參與區域與國家級醫療會議；與支付方合作，以取得及時的給付覆蓋，並有利於毛利率轉淨折扣；我們的neffyconnect計畫，為醫師與患者提供支持，包括我們的25美元共付金儲蓄卡、199美元現金價格與患者協助計畫；我們的neffyinSchools計畫，截至目前為止已有超過9,000所學校選擇免費取得兩盒neffy，並搭配校內護理師的neffy教育；與患者倡議組織的合作，包括疾病意識活動；以及多渠道的品牌直接對消費者廣告，包括連線電視、診斷現場、內嵌與程式化展示、社交媒體與付費搜尋，於2025年5月啟動，以及線性電視廣告於2025年6月啟動。為減少親臨醫療專業人員訪問的時間負擔，我們也在2025年11月啟動了一項名為"Get neffy on Us"的新商業計畫，提供患者免費與虛擬處方醫師會面，並為具商業保險資格的患者提供零共付金。我們也在2025年第二季啟動了一項美國上市後的註冊研究，用於neffy治療過敏性休克，於口服食物挑戰或過敏原免疫療法診所進行，目前仍在進行中。

歐盟藥物管理局（EMA）已授予EURneffy 2 mg（在歐盟及英國銷售的neffy 2 mg商品名）於成人及體重30公斤或以上兒童的緊急治療Type I過敏反應（包括過敏性休克）的上市許可，並於2026年1月29日，人用藥物產品委員會（CHMP）採納了正面意見，建議在歐盟授予EURneffy 1 mg上市許可，用於四歲以上且體重15公斤至少於30公斤的兒童。透過與ALK的合作，EURneffy 2 mg於歐洲上市，首先於2025年6月在德國啟動，隨後於2025年10月在英國啟動。我們在2025年9月獲得neffy 2 mg及1 mg在日本的上市許可，預計由合作夥伴Alfresa於2026年第一季啟動上市。我們也在2025年12月獲得neffy 2 mg及1 mg劑型在澳洲的上市許可，由合作夥伴Seqirus於2026年2月啟動商業上市。2025年12月，我們在中國獲得優敏速（neffy 2 mg在中國的商品名）的上市許可，預計由合作夥伴Pediatrix於2026年第一季啟動商業上市。neffy 2 mg目前正由加拿大衛生部審查，預計於2026年第二季做出監管決定，若獲批准，預計由合作夥伴ALK於2026年後期啟動商業上市。neffy目前已獲批准或正在進行監管審查的國家，約佔目前全球腎上腺素自動注射器銷售的98%。

真實世界數據支持neffy在緊急治療Type I過敏反應時，其反應率與注射療法相似。2025年9月，我們報告了neffy體驗計畫中過敏性休克治療結果的調查結果，該計畫為過敏科醫師提供1 mg及2 mg劑型的neffy，用於診所內使用，若患者在口服食物挑戰或過敏原免疫療法期間出現過敏性休克症狀。這些結果顯示，約有90%的過敏性休克症狀患者經單劑neffy治療後有效，與歷史報告的腎上腺素注射療法結果一致。這些結果以口述簡報形式於2025年11月初的美國過敏、氣喘與免疫學會（ACAAI）會議中發表，並於2025年12月發表於《過敏、氣喘與免疫學年鑑》（ACAAI官方同儕審查期刊）。
我們在2024年2月的美國過敏與免疫學會醫學會議上報告了正面的初步結果，顯示對治療抵抗性慢性蕁麻疹患者有統計學上顯著且臨牀上有意義的改善。2025年第二季，我們啟動了一項針對慢性自發性蕁麻疹患者的第二期雙盲、安慰劑對照的門診臨牀試驗，這些患者正在接受慢性治療，但仍會出現發作或惡化。此臨牀試驗的中期數據預計於2026年下半年公佈，隨後可能於2027年中啟動單一關鍵性有效性試驗。

自2015年成立ARS Pharmaceuticals, Inc.以來，我們已將幾乎所有努力投入於智慧財產權的開發、產品開發與臨牀試驗、組織與人力配置、商業規劃、籌資、基礎設施建設、預商業與商業活動，以及提供一般及行政支援。我們的營運資金主要來自2022年11月與Silverback Therapeutics, Inc. ("Silverback") 合併的資金、私募發行可轉換優先股、發行普通股、授權、供應與分銷安排與我們商業化夥伴、債務以及淨產品銷售。截至2025年12月31日，我們持有現金、現金等價物及短期投資共245.0 百萬美元。

自我們成立以來，我們在大多數年份都產生淨虧損。截至2025年12月31日的年度淨虧損為171.3 百萬美元，而截至2024年12月31日的年度淨收入為8.0 百萬美元。截至2025年12月31日，我們累積虧損為294.6 百萬美元。在我們能持續產生正向淨收入之前，若有的話，我們的淨虧損可能因臨牀試驗的時間、其他開發活動的支出、規管文件的費用、建立、維持與提升銷售、行銷與分銷能力的費用、產品銷售的時間與數量，以及我們在授權與合作安排下獲得潛在特許權使用費與規管與商業里程碑的能力而大幅波動。

在我們能產生顯著產品收入之前，我們可能透過現有現金、現金等價物、短期投資、股權發行、債務融資及其他資金來源來資助營運，這些資金來源可能包括合作、戰略聯盟、行銷、分銷或授權安排或其他與第三方的安排。然而，我們可能無法在需要時以有利條件或完全無法取得額外資金或進行這些其他安排。此外，任何未來的債務協議可能限制我們在未獲得貸款人同意的情況下進行某些債務融資。2025年9月29日，我們與RA Capital Agency Services, LLC（作為"行政代理"）及OMERS Administration Corporation與RA Capital Management, L.P.的 affiliates（作為"貸款人"）簽訂了信貸協議（"信貸協議"），提供貸款人最多250.0 百萬美元的貸款（"信貸設施"）。根據信貸協議，除有限例外情況外，我們不得在貸款人書面同意前產生額外債務或進行某些戰略與授權交易。我們若無法在需要時籌措資金或進行這些其他安排，將對我們的財務狀況產生負面影響，並可能導致我們延遲或減少行銷與銷售努力，或延遲、減少或終止我們的研究與開發計畫或其他營運，或讓與他人開發與行銷產品或產品候選藥物的權利，而我們原本希望自行開發與行銷。
我們不擁有或經營製造設施。我們目前依賴第三方製造商與供應商來製造neffy與我們的鼻內腎上腺素技術產品候選藥物，我們預期將持續如此以應對我們的非臨牀、臨牀與商業活動。我們的第三方製造商必須根據cGMP要求及其他適用法律與規範製造我們的產品。

自2024年9月neffy商業發售以來，我們已在美國認列產品銷售收入。我們已與美國以外所有地理區域簽訂合作與授權協議。這些協議的條款可能包括支付給我們的下列項目之一或更多：不可退款的 upfront 授權費用；臨牀、規管與/或商業里程碑付款；臨牀開發費用；以及若neffy在這些地區獲得上市許可，則根據銷售的授權產品支付特許權使用費或轉讓價格。我們預期未來期間的產品收入將因我們持續進行neffy的商業發售而波動。我們預期合作協議下的收入將因我們達成各項規管里程碑的能力，以及成功取得neffy在授權地區的規管許可、商業里程碑、特許權使用費或轉讓價格，以及根據前述協議中所述的產品供應情況而波動。

銷售成本主要由製造neffy供商業銷售的直接與間接成本組成，包括第三方製造成本、原材料與零組件成本、過多或過時存貨調整費用、存貨寫跌費用、包裝服務、運輸費用、儲存費用、分銷費用、資本化授權成本的攤銷、產品銷售的特許權使用費、員工薪資與相關費用，以及股票基於報酬。在美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）於2024年8月批准neffy之前，某些存貨零組件已購入以製造neffy並記錄為研究與開發費用，導致零成本存貨零組件。因此，與neffy相關的銷售成本將最初反映較低的平均單價材料成本，因先前已費用化的存貨零組件在商業生產中被消耗並售出給客戶。

headings: 與本公司業務相關的風險
若本公司無法自行或透過與行銷夥伴的合作，充分發展並維持銷售、行銷及分銷能力，則可能無法成功商業化 neffy。
neffy 以及本公司鼻內給藥腎上腺素技術的市場可能小於我們預期。
若本公司無法在合理價格條款下達成並維持第三方支付者對 neffy 的覆蓋及賠償，其商業成功可能受到嚴重阻礙。
paragraphs: 我們營運於一個動態且快速變化的環境中，涉及許多風險與不確定性。某些因素可能對我們的業務、財務狀況及營運結果產生重大不利影響，您應謹慎考量這些因素。因此，在評估我們的業務時，我們鼓勵您一併考量以下風險因素的完整討論，以及本年度報告及我們其他向美國證券交易委員會（SEC）公開檔中所包含的其他資訊。其他我們目前未預期或認為不重要的事件，也可能影響我們的營運結果與財務狀況。
我們高度依賴 neffy 的成功商業化。若 neffy 及 EURneffy 未能成功商業化，將對我們的業務、財務狀況及營運結果產生重大不利影響，並可能導致我們普通股的價格顯著下跌。

neffy 是我們唯一已獲批准可供銷售的產品。目前，neffy 已獲批准用於美國、歐盟、英國、日本及澳洲（在 neffy 2 mg 及 1 mg 的情況下）以及中國（在 neffy 2 mg 的情況下）用於緊急治療過敏反應（過敏性休克）。我們將大量資源與活動集中在 neffy 上，我們認為我們近期的收入高度依賴於，且公司價值的有意義部分與我們成功在美國及國際市場透過合作夥伴商業化 neffy 的能力有關。成功商業化 neffy 受許多風險影響。在 neffy 之前，我們作為一個組織，未曾成功商業化任何產品，且沒有保證我們能成功以 neffy 進行商業化。許多產品發行失敗或未能達成市場潛力高期待的案例，包括一些擁有更多經驗與資源的藥物公司。neffy 的商業成功取決於患者與醫師是否接受並採用 neffy 作為 Type I 過敏反應（包括過敏性休克）的治療，我們不確定我們或他人在此方面的估計是否準確。例如，若可能遭受 Type I 過敏反應的患者人數少於我們的估計，或醫師不願意處方或患者不願意使用 neffy 的任何原因，neffy 的商業潛力將受到限制。目前還太早知道醫師、患者及付款人對 neffy 價格的反應。若未提供覆蓋或報銷不足以覆蓋大部分成本，醫師可能不會處方 neffy，患者也可能不願意使用 neffy。此外，任何 neffy 在核准後試驗中的負面發展或潛在額外適應症（包括蕁麻疹）或在其他司法管轄區的監管程序中的問題，都可能對 neffy 的商業結果與潛力產生不利影響。因此，關於 neffy 的商業潛力仍存在重大不確定性。若 neffy 的商業化失敗或被視為令人失望，我們的股票價格可能大幅下跌，且該產品與我們公司的長期成功可能受到損害。
我們已建立銷售團隊，並簽訂 ALK 共同推廣協議以在美國商業化 neffy。為成功商業化 neffy，我們必須，除其他事項外，持續建立我們的銷售、行銷、分銷、管理及其他非技術能力。可能阻礙我們成功行銷與商業分銷產品的因素包括：
• 銷售人員無法取得足夠數量的醫師接觸或教育他們關於處方 neffy 的效益與安全性；
• 無法招募、留住並有效管理足夠數量的高效銷售人員，包括 ALK 美國銷售人員；
